sentences.en: What has many holes but is good for holding liquid?
sentences.zh: 什么东西有很多孔却能装液体？

sentences.en: I prefer soap as a liquid rather than a bar.
sentences.zh: 我更喜欢用液态肥皂而不是固体肥皂。

sentences.en: Are there any liquids or sharp objects in your luggage?
sentences.zh: 你的行李里有液体或尖锐物品吗？
